salida_final.en: Dear member: we reviewed the request for aesthetic rhinoplasty. Unfortunately we cannot authorize it, because this procedure is excluded from the benefit plan as it is a cosmetic surgery without a documented functional impairment. If a functional condition that justifies the procedure arises in the future, you may submit a new request with the corresponding documentation. For any questions, please contact your health service provider.
